setting.name: Disable Microsoft Edge Features
setting.casual_explanation: This writes a large Microsoft Edge policy bundle that turns off or tightens several browser features.
setting.why_people_change_it: People use it when they want a quieter Edge setup with fewer UI, sync, and personalization features enabled.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The bundle is explicit and reversible, but it is still a first-party provider card rather than a promoted research-provider surface.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this tweak through app/Services/TweakProviders/PrivacyTweakProvider.cs and engine/Tweaks/Misc/DisableEdgeFeaturesTweaks.cs. The current engine tweak writes a coordinated bundle across the Edge policy path and the legacy EdgeUI policy path. This record keeps the live behavior documented without publishing it as a validated research-provider card yet.
